name: Velodrome
notes: Colored: the official brand-kit symbol.svg unchanged (two interlocking rings striped #FF1100, #FDBF41, #F1ECE2 and #007FFF, with the kit's 48% #191919 shadow gradient), placed on the 64 grid

Mono: the same paths in the same painting order, read in black and white by luminance: the #FF1100 and #007FFF stripes are ink, the #FDBF41 and #F1ECE2 stripes are knocked out by a mask, and the shadow is dropped, so each ring stays a readable double band
